description: Every SvGrid capability is off by default, so a bare <SvGrid> is a plain read-only table. This Svelte 5 example switches sorting, filtering, editing, selection, grouping, paging, column resize and row resize on one boolean prop at a time, with no features array and no fine-grained props, and shows the resulting config live. Capabilities that stay off are never downloaded, because their code loads on demand.

faq.question: Do I have to import tableFeatures to enable sorting or filtering?
faq.answer: No. The boolean shortcut props sortable, filterable, editable, selectable, groupable and pageable each inject the feature they need. tableFeatures is the fine-grained route for when you want to configure a feature beyond its defaults.

faq.question: What does a grid with no capabilities enabled cost?
faq.answer: Only the core renderer. Column resize and row resize, for example, are loaded on demand the first time a grid turns them on, so a grid that never enables them never fetches that code.

faq.question: How do I autosize a column?
faq.answer: With columnResize on, drag a header edge to set a width or double-click the edge to fit the column to its content.
